description: ENHANCED: header normalization edge cases — three multi-values are combined, and a request id from the request context is exposed as x-request-id.

cases.expected_output:
[request]
request.headers.x-trip=1,2,3
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=17
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>

[request]
request.headers.x-request-id=req-abc-123
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=17
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>
